# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.7.0

Describe a video, image or voiceover in Codex and HolyCrab selects the relevant creative guide, prepares the request, quotes credits and executes within your approval.

- Bundle five creative guides: video production, product images, voiceovers, Seedance prompts and H3 storyboards, behind one automatically selected HolyCrab Skill.
- Save and resume multi-step workflows. Query existing tasks after interruptions, reuse completed outputs and revise individual shots without silently generating duplicates.
- Download clips and compose a finished MP4 locally with trimming, canvas normalization, music, narration and timed Chinese/Latin subtitles. Local composition requires working FFmpeg and FFprobe. Automatic transcription is not included.
- Show concise terminal progress and useful recovery actions. `--json-output` exposes full creative records; piped output remains JSON. Distinguish API Key quota from account balance.
- Provide self-contained CLI and individual Skill archives, with bundled resource hashes and installation ownership checks.

## Install or update

Use the attached installers or run `holycrab update`. Reopen Codex after installation so it discovers the new Skill. Python 3.10 or newer is required. Keep your API Key in local setup.

The complete archive contains `LOCAL-INSTALL.md`: extract it and use the local-source installation command there. Individual `.skill` files require an installed CLI 0.7.0 or newer.

## Validation scope

The creative Agent flow was validated with Codex on macOS: one real silent Seedance Mini video, interrupted-wait recovery, verified download, timed Chinese subtitles and complete MP4 decoding. Nine additional local media scenarios passed. Audio generation and other Agent hosts were not newly live-tested for this release. Native platform installation and protocol checks run in CI; Codex reply brevity can still vary with the host/model.

Existing authorization/upload implementation bytes are unchanged from v0.6.0. Its recorded live upload evidence is reused with explicit component hashes and fresh read-only queries; no new identity verification or personal-media upload is claimed. Windows v0.5.0 self-update retains its known old-launcher limitation; use the installer for that upgrade path.
